title: Confidence isn't something you talk yourself into. You *earn it.*

label: HOW IT WORKS
head: Every promise you break to yourself costs you
sub: Your brain keeps score. Break enough promises and you stop believing your own word.

label: LEVEL 1
head: Get up when the alarm rings
sub: First promise of the day. Most guys break it before 7am.

label: LEVEL 2
head: Finish the 3 things you planned
sub: Not 7. Three. Then do all three.

label: LEVEL 3
head: Train when you don't feel like it
sub: The workouts you almost skipped count double.

label: LEVEL 4
head: Say no when you mean no
sub: Every fake yes teaches you that your word is cheap.

label: LEVEL 5
head: Keep the promise nobody would know you broke
Every kept promise is a *vote* for who you are.
